Skill Type:

Max Level:

Requirements:

Skill Trainers:
None
“
Represents your metabolic efficiency when consuming raw meats.
Beast Metabolism Overview
Beast Metabolism
is a secondary skill under
Lycanthropy
that helps you get more benefit out of eating corpses while in wolf form.
In-Game Description
Represents your metabolic efficiency when consuming raw meats.
Training Beast Metabolism
A
Lycanthrope
will obtain
Beast Metabolism
when they first consume a carcass in wolf form.
Connected Skills
Sub-Skills:
None.
Secondary Skills:
Lycanthropy
-
Beast Metabolism
is a skill given to those with Lycanthropy.
Related Skills:
Beast Speech
- Beast Speech is another skill that all Lycanthropes learn.
Beast Metabolism Mechanics
Leveling Beast Metabolism
Every time you eat a corpse in wolf form, you will get experience towards this skill.
